limitations: Short synthetic walks do not prove long-duration/hardware behavior.
Loopback receiver shares CPU/GPU resources; timings vary with contention.
Nested sections are inclusive; do not sum overlapping parent and child timers.
Frozen-state public getter microbench excludes physics and optimizer; not a step-time estimate.
Detailed timers and synchronous shadow state comparisons add diagnostic overhead.

The detailed state.host_copy label hooks global torch.Tensor.cpu Python dispatch. Its count includes nested tensor-subclass dispatch and other main-thread CPU calls; it is not a physical CUDA memcpy count. Single packet conversion is covered by code and the focused Tensor.cpu regression.
Full Sim gate has one independently reproduced pre-existing RL waypoint/limit failure; required/extended/all-release gates were not rerun.
